title: Armadok data backups
explain: Copies of Armadok's own data: accounts, rights, settings, the audit log and the identity key workers trust. They are encrypted with the encryption key. Keep that key somewhere else: without it a backup cannot be opened.
noKey: No encryption key is set, so no backup can be made (the identity key would be stored in clear text).
schedule: A backup is made every {{hours}} hours; the newest {{keep}} are kept.
manualOnly: Automatic backups are off; the newest {{keep}} are kept.
sameDisk: They are stored next to the data: if the disk is lost, so are they. Set ARMADOK_STATE_BACKUP_DIR to another disk.
restoreHow: With Armadok stopped, run this command with the same encryption key. The current files are kept aside, not deleted.
